resources.string: Gestures and touch
VoiceOver gestures

You can use the gestures of VoiceOver on iPhone. Go to Settings, Gestures, Gesture layout, and choose VoiceOver gestures. Each layout keeps your changes to the gestures of that layout. In the VoiceOver layout, two-finger swipes run SandFly commands. To turn this on or off, use Handle two-finger swipes in SandFly.
Back tap

You can run commands with a double or triple tap on the back of the device. Go to Settings, Gestures, and under Back tap, choose Double tap on back or Triple tap on back. To change how firm a tap must be, use Back tap sensitivity.
Swipes along the edges

You can slide one finger along an edge of the screen: up or down the left or right edge, or left or right along the top or bottom edge. Start at the very edge, and keep your finger near it. To assign commands, go to Settings, Gestures, and under Edges, choose a gesture such as Swipe up along the left edge. To scroll apps with one finger along an edge instead, turn on Scroll with one finger along the left edge, or the switch for another edge, under Edges.
Edge menus

The left and right edges can each be a menu of up to 10 commands. Go to Settings, Gestures, Left edge menu or Right edge menu, turn on Use the left edge as a menu or Use the right edge as a menu, and choose Add command. To use the menu, start at the very edge and slide up or down along it. SandFly speaks each command as your finger reaches it, and lifting your finger runs the command.
Volume key presses

You can assign commands to double presses, triple presses and long presses of the volume keys. Go to Settings, Volume keys, and choose a press, such as Volume up double press. A key with no assigned press changes the volume as before.
Hold to cancel

With Lift to activate, lifting your finger at the edge of the screen now activates nothing. To make lifting activate nothing after you hold your finger on an item, go to Settings, Touch, Hold to cancel, and choose a time.
Tap to activate
A quick tap activates the item under your finger without focusing it first. Go to Settings, Touch, and turn on Tap to activate. This setting needs Android 13 or later.
Speech and sound
Speech equalizer

You can change the sound of speech with a 12-band equalizer. Go to Settings, Speech, Equalizer, and choose a Preset, or move the slider of each band. Each voice profile has its own Equalizer, on the screen of the profile. The equalizer needs Low-latency audio, in Settings, Audio output.
Keep speech on the phone while casting

To keep SandFly speech and sounds on the phone during screen casting and mirroring, go to Settings, Audio output, and turn on Keep speech on the phone while casting. Screen recordings then have no SandFly audio. This setting needs Android 10 or later.
Announce full charge
To hear \"Battery fully charged\" when the battery is full while the charger is connected, go to Settings, Verbosity, and turn on Announce full charge.
Voice for time announcements
To choose the voice that says the time at a set interval, go to Settings, Notifications, Summary and time, Voice. You can choose the notification voice, the SandFly voice or a voice profile.
Speaking while the device is locked

An app that supports it can speak through SandFly while the device is locked, once you allow this separately. To change this later, go to Settings, Speech, Let other apps speak, and use the switch named after the app, such as Tasker while the device is locked.
Braille
Braille display keys

You can change the keys of each braille display command, and give display keys to the commands that gestures run. Go to Settings, Braille, Braille display, Braille display commands, choose a command, and choose Change keys. Then press the new keys on the display.
Braille dictionary
You can change how text is shown on a braille display, in all apps or in one app. Go to Settings, Braille, Braille dictionary, and choose Add a replacement.
Hide the on-screen keyboard
To keep other on-screen keyboards hidden while a braille display is connected, go to Settings, Braille, Braille display, and turn on Hide the on-screen keyboard.
Emoji search

On the braille keyboard, hold dots 4, 5 and 6, and swipe right. Type words of the emoji name in uncontracted braille. To move between the emoji that match, swipe down or up with one finger. To insert the emoji, swipe right with two fingers.
Update dot positions with one hand, then the other

On the braille keyboard, hold three fingers of one hand on the screen, then put down three fingers of the other hand, and keep all six still. To turn this off, go to Settings, Braille, Braille keyboard.
Commands
To assign these commands to a gesture or a keyboard shortcut, go to Settings, Commands.
App shortcuts
Opens the shortcuts that a long press on an app icon on the home screen shows. To add a shortcut from an app such as MacroDroid, go to Settings, Gestures, App shortcuts, and choose Add app shortcut.
Clear text
Removes all text from the focused edit box.
Turn color inversion on or off
Turns Android color inversion on or off. This command needs Shizuku.
Use voice profile
Switches to SandFly default or to one voice profile. There is a Use voice profile command for SandFly default and for each voice profile.
Turn SandFly keyboard input on or off

While SandFly keyboard input is off, every key of a physical keyboard goes to Android and the app in front, except the keys of this command: SandFly key + Shift + K, or SandFly key + Shift + Semicolon in the VoiceOver and Orca keymaps.
Turn off SandFly
Turns SandFly off after you confirm, and gives touch handling back to Android, so that the next screen reader, such as TalkBack, gets your touches. This command is also in the SandFly menu.
AI and dictation
AI actions reading control

Swipe up or down to choose Describe screen, Describe image, or one of the Speak and Ask commands, then double-tap to run it. To choose the actions in the reading control, go to Settings, Reading controls, AI actions to include.
Speak and Ask commands

Speak screen description and Speak image description speak the description instead of showing it in a window. Ask about screen and Ask about image take a screenshot, then record your question with dictation, and SandFly speaks the answer. The commands are in Settings, Commands, Image and screen descriptions.
Report AI response
Opens a problem report with the text of the last AI response, for a response that is offensive or wrong. The command is in Settings, Commands, Image and screen descriptions.
Model file
To use a whisper.cpp model file of your own for dictation, go to Settings, Typing, Dictation, and under Whisper models, choose Model file.
Correction prompt
To change the instructions that the AI service gets for correcting dictation, go to Settings, Typing, Dictation, Correction prompt.
Remove this device
To use your SandFly Pro code on another device, go to Settings, SandFly Pro, and choose Remove this device. SandFly Pro turns off on this device, and you can activate the code on another device.
Other features
Search
Search, at the top of the main settings screen, finds settings and commands on every settings screen. Search is also at the top of Gestures, Keyboard shortcuts and the list of commands for a gesture.
Links, phone numbers and codes

The Actions menu and the Actions reading control list the web addresses, email addresses, phone numbers and codes in the text of the focused item, to open, call or copy. To choose which kinds are listed, go to Settings, Reading controls, Actions found in text.
Go to quoted message
In Telegram, the actions of a message that replies to another include Go to quoted message, which shows the quoted message.
Show the focus indicator
To hide the border around the focused item, go to Settings, Display, Focus indicator, and turn off Show the focus indicator.
Scripts
Scripts can now use edge gestures, pinch, spread, two-finger scrub and swipe and hold, change the title and summary of a script setting, and send every key to the app.
